outcome: use of nonstandard ARVs during pregnancy
cohort: 82 pregnant women (41 with perinatal HIV and 41 with nonperinatal HIV)
finding: Women with perinatal HIV infection were more likely to have HIV drug resistance mutations and receive nonstandard antiretroviral therapy during pregnancy than women with nonperinatal HIV infection.
mod_finding: Despite nonstandard ARV use during pregnancy, PHIV women did not experience increased rates of adverse pregnancy outcomes.
